content: With random numbers fixed by seed, draws train_size training images and test_size test images, keeping the share of each digit (stratified). The default counts keep the seven classifiers' run time within a minute. Scales pixels to 0–1, makes them 784-dimensional vectors, and passes them to every classifier in an npz file. Shows the count per digit.

outputs.name: subset
outputs.description: The normalised subset (an npz of train_images, train_labels, test_images, test_labels, digest)
